description: This file defines an abstract class 'MethodOperation' which serves as a base for implementing various operations within a mini-language framework in the OFBiz project. It includes method signatures for executing operations and converting them to strings, along with nested annotations and factory interface.

classes.name: MethodOperation
classes.description: An abstract base class for mini-language element models that perform operations during script execution, requiring subclasses to implement execution logic.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation within the given method context. Returns true if script execution should continue, false otherwise.

methods.name: expandedString
methods.description: Creates a string representation of the operation using the current environment context, marked as deprecated.

methods.name: rawString
methods.description: Returns a string similar to the original XML element, marked as deprecated.
